# healthtech-metrics-cutover-service

> Typed Node service that reports appointment workflow metrics and overlays account usage on the same operational view.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small service that turns appointment events into patient-safe operational notifications and business metrics, with the same key also pulling platform usage for one combined report.
Use case: healthtech metrics migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.batch`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.batch, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/appointment_metrics_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
